customers.description: Order-side customer records: one row per order placed. The same person can appear under several customer_id values, so customer_id is not a person identifier. Count real customers with customer_unique_id.

columns.customer_id: Primary key. Customer record attached to one order; referenced by orders.customer_id. 99,441 distinct values.
columns.customer_unique_id: Identifier of the actual customer (person). Repeats across orders from the same person: 96,096 distinct values across 99,441 rows. Use COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) for customer counts.
columns.customer_zip_code_prefix: First digits of the customer's CEP postal code. The source stores it as an integer, so leading zeros are lost (e.g. 1037 means 01037). Do not zero-pad silently.
columns.customer_city: Customer city name in Portuguese, lowercase in the source (e.g. 'sao paulo').
columns.customer_state: Customer state as a 2-letter Brazilian UF code (e.g. SP, RJ). 27 distinct values.

orders.description: One row per order with lifecycle timestamps and a final status snapshot. Central table joining customers, order_items, order_payments and order_reviews. Purchase timestamps range from 2016-09-04 to 2018-10-17.

columns.order_id: Primary key. Unique order identifier (32-char hex).
columns.customer_id: Foreign key to customers.customer_id. Identifies the order-side customer record, not necessarily a unique person.
columns.order_status: Final status snapshot. One of: approved, canceled, created, delivered, invoiced, processing, shipped, unavailable. 'canceled' (625 orders) and 'unavailable' (609 orders) are distinct outcomes; 96,478 orders are delivered.
columns.order_purchase_timestamp: When the order was placed. Never NULL. Anchor timestamp for time-series analysis.
columns.order_approved_at: When the order was approved (payment confirmation). NULL for 160 orders that were never approved.
columns.order_delivered_carrier_date: When the order was handed to the carrier. NULL for 1,783 orders.
columns.order_delivered_customer_date: When the customer received the order. NULL for 2,965 orders, including 8 orders whose status is 'delivered'.
columns.order_estimated_delivery_date: Delivery date promised to the customer at purchase time. Never NULL. Useful for on-time-delivery analysis.

product_category_translation.description: Lookup table mapping Portuguese category names to English (71 rows). Incomplete: the categories 'pc_gamer' and 'portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos' used by 13 products are missing. Always LEFT JOIN; never assume a translation exists.

columns.product_category_name: Primary key. Portuguese category name exactly as used in products.product_category_name.

products.description: One row per product (32,951). Category and physical attributes are nullable. Column names intentionally keep the source CSV's 'lenght' misspelling.

columns.product_id: Primary key. Unique product identifier (32-char hex).
columns.product_category_name: Portuguese category name. NULL for 610 products; 13 products use categories absent from product_category_translation. No enforced foreign key — join with LEFT JOIN.
columns.product_name_lenght: Number of characters in the product name (source spelling: 'lenght'). NULL for 610 products.
columns.product_description_lenght: Number of characters in the product description (source spelling: 'lenght'). NULL for 610 products.
columns.product_photos_qty: Number of product photos on the listing. NULL for 610 products.
columns.product_weight_g: Product weight in grams. NULL for 2 products.
columns.product_length_cm: Product length in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.
columns.product_height_cm: Product height in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.
columns.product_width_cm: Product width in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.

order_items.description: Order line items (112,650 rows). Grain is one row per unit: buying 3 units of a product creates 3 rows with order_item_id 1..3. Quantity is a count of rows, not a column. Price and freight are per-unit monetary values in BRL.

columns.order_id: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key (order_id, order_item_id).
columns.order_item_id: Sequence number of the unit within the order (1 to 21). Part of the composite primary key.
columns.seller_id: Seller that fulfilled this item. All values verified against the source sellers CSV, but the FK is deferred until the sellers table is imported.
columns.shipping_limit_date: Deadline for the seller to hand the item to the carrier.
columns.price: Merchandise value of one unit in BRL, numeric(10,2). Excludes freight. SUM(price) is gross item value — NOT net revenue (refunds are not observable in this dataset).
columns.freight_value: Shipping value allocated to this item in BRL, numeric(10,2). SUM(freight_value) gives total freight charged.

order_payments.description: Payment transactions (103,886 rows). An order can have multiple payment rows (e.g. voucher plus credit card); sum payment_value per order for the total paid. Exactly one order has no payment row.

columns.order_id: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key (order_id, payment_sequential).
columns.payment_sequential: Sequence number of the payment transaction within the order. Part of the composite primary key.
columns.payment_type: One of: credit_card, boleto, debit_card, voucher, not_defined.
columns.payment_installments: Number of installments chosen for the payment (observed range 0 to 24).
columns.payment_value: Transaction value in BRL, numeric(10,2). Includes freight. SUM over an order's rows equals the total paid for that order.

order_reviews.description: Customer reviews (99,224 rows). Primary key is (review_id, order_id) because review_id alone repeats across orders (1,603 rows share a review_id). Scores are 1-5; comment text is mostly NULL.

columns.review_id: Review identifier. NOT unique on its own — the same review can appear for multiple orders. Part of the composite primary key.
columns.order_id: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key. An order may have more than one review.
columns.review_score: Review score from 1 to 5 stars (CHECK constraint enforced).
columns.review_comment_title: Optional review title in Portuguese. NULL for 87,656 rows.
columns.review_comment_message: Optional review message in Portuguese. NULL for 58,247 rows.
columns.review_creation_date: Date the review was created (time component is midnight).
columns.review_answer_timestamp: Timestamp when the review was answered/processed.
